datasets.name: ds_driver_race
queryLines:
SELECT b.*,
       CASE WHEN b.dnf_flag                      THEN 'retired'
            WHEN b.quali_to_finish_delta >=  2   THEN 'made up places'
            WHEN b.quali_to_finish_delta <= -2   THEN 'lost places'
            ELSE 'held position' END AS form_verdict
FROM (
SELECT d.season, d.round, d.race_date, d.race_name,
       d.circuit_name, d.circuit_country,
       d.driver_name,
       d.constructor_name_as_of_race            AS team,
       d.grid_position, d.finish_position, d.positions_gained,
       d.quali_position, d.quali_stage_reached, d.quali_to_finish_delta,
       d.race_points, d.sprint_points, d.total_points,
       d.dnf_flag, d.status, d.is_win, d.is_podium, d.is_points_finish,
       p.pace_deficit_pct, p.consistency_s, p.laps_led, p.median_clean_lap_s,
       s.stops, s.stints, s.avg_service_stop_s, s.strategy_vs_field
FROM driver_performance d
LEFT JOIN lap_pace p
       ON p.season = d.season AND p.round = d.round AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN race_strategy s
       ON s.season = d.season AND s.round = d.round AND s.driver_id = d.driver_id
) b

datasets.name: ds_driver_season
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.season, d.driver_name,
         d.constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
         d.quali_position, d.finish_position, d.quali_to_finish_delta,
         d.total_points, d.dnf_flag, d.is_win, d.is_podium, d.positions_gained,
         p.pace_deficit_pct, p.consistency_s, p.laps_led
  FROM driver_performance d
  LEFT JOIN lap_pace p
         ON p.season = d.season AND p.round = d.round AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
team_pace AS (
  SELECT season, team, AVG(pace_deficit_pct) AS team_pace_deficit
  FROM base WHERE team IS NOT NULL GROUP BY season, team
)
SELECT b.season, b.driver_name, b.team,
       COUNT(*)                                        AS races,
       SUM(b.total_points)                             AS points,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.is_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)       AS wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.is_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS podiums,
       ROUND(AVG(b.quali_position), 2)                 AS avg_quali,
       ROUND(AVG(b.finish_position), 2)                AS avg_finish,
       ROUND(AVG(b.quali_to_finish_delta), 2)          AS avg_places_made_up,
       ROUND(AVG(b.pace_deficit_pct), 3)               AS avg_pace_deficit_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(b.pace_deficit_pct) - MAX(t.team_pace_deficit), 3)
                                                       AS pace_vs_team_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(b.consistency_s), 3)                  AS avg_consistency_s,
       SUM(b.laps_led)                                 AS laps_led,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.dnf_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS dnfs,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN b.dnf_flag THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1)
                                                       AS dnf_rate_pct
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN team_pace t ON t.season = b.season AND t.team = b.team
GROUP BY b.season, b.driver_name, b.team

datasets.name: ds_team_season
queryLines:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.season, d.constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
         d.quali_position, d.finish_position, d.total_points,
         d.dnf_flag, d.is_win, d.is_podium, d.is_points_finish,
         p.pace_deficit_pct, s.avg_service_stop_s
  FROM driver_performance d
  LEFT JOIN lap_pace p
         ON p.season = d.season AND p.round = d.round AND p.driver_id = d.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN race_strategy s
         ON s.season = d.season AND s.round = d.round AND s.driver_id = d.driver_id
  WHERE d.constructor_name_as_of_race IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT season, team,
       COUNT(*)                                     AS car_races,
       SUM(total_points)                            AS points,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)      AS wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)   AS podiums,
       ROUND(AVG(quali_position), 2)                AS avg_quali,
       ROUND(AVG(finish_position), 2)               AS avg_finish,
       ROUND(AVG(pace_deficit_pct), 3)              AS avg_pace_deficit_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(avg_service_stop_s), 2)            AS avg_pit_stop_s,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN dnf_flag THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS dnf_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN is_points_finish THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS points_finish_pct
FROM base
GROUP BY season, team

datasets.name: ds_circuit
queryLines:
WITH outcomes AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, circuit_country, season, round,
         SUM(CASE WHEN grid_position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                AS poles,
         SUM(CASE WHEN grid_position = 1 AND is_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS pole_wins
  FROM driver_performance
  GROUP BY circuit_name, circuit_country, season, round
),
strategy AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, season, round,
         MAX(field_modal_stops) AS modal_stops,
         MAX(field_stop_spread) AS stop_spread
  FROM race_strategy
  GROUP BY circuit_name, season, round
),
conditions AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, season, round, avg_abs_positions_changed,
         retirement_rate_pct, was_wet
  FROM race_conditions
)
SELECT o.circuit_name, o.circuit_country,
       COUNT(*)                                            AS races,
       MODE(s.modal_stops)                                 AS typical_stops,
       ROUND(AVG(s.stop_spread), 2)                        AS avg_stop_spread,
       ROUND(AVG(c.avg_abs_positions_changed), 2)          AS overtaking_index,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.pole_wins) / NULLIF(SUM(o.poles), 0), 1) AS pole_to_win_pct,
       ROUND(AVG(c.retirement_rate_pct), 1)                AS avg_retirement_rate_pct,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.was_wet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS wet_races
FROM outcomes o
LEFT JOIN strategy s   ON s.circuit_name = o.circuit_name AND s.season = o.season AND s.round = o.round
LEFT JOIN conditions c ON c.circuit_name = o.circuit_name AND c.season = o.season AND c.round = o.round
GROUP BY o.circuit_name, o.circuit_country

datasets.name: ds_championship
queryLines:
SELECT season, round, race_date, race_name, driver_name,
       constructor_name_as_of_race AS team,
       championship_position, cumulative_points, cumulative_wins,
       gap_to_leader, points_gained_in_round, position_change_vs_prev_round,
       is_championship_leader
FROM championship_progression

datasets.name: ds_dq
queryLines:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT origin.update_id AS update_id, timestamp AS event_time,
         origin.flow_name AS dataset_name,
         explode(from_json(
           get_json_object(details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations'),
           'ARRAY<STRUCT<name STRING, passed_records BIGINT, failed_records BIGINT>>'
         )) AS x
  FROM pipeline_event_log
  WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress'
    AND get_json_object(details, '$.flow_progress.data_quality.expectations') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT dataset_name, x.name AS expectation_name,
       SUM(x.passed_records) AS passed_records,
       SUM(x.failed_records) AS failed_records,
       MAX(event_time)       AS last_run
FROM e GROUP BY dataset_name, x.name

datasets.name: ds_driver_standings
queryLines:
WITH final AS (
  SELECT season, MAX(round) AS last_round FROM championship_progression GROUP BY season
),
standings AS (
  SELECT c.season,
         c.championship_position          AS position,
         c.driver_name,
         c.constructor_name_as_of_race    AS team,
         c.cumulative_points              AS points,
         c.cumulative_wins                AS wins,
         c.gap_to_leader
  FROM championship_progression c
  JOIN final f ON f.season = c.season AND f.last_round = c.round
)
SELECT s.*,
       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN position = 2 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS title_margin,
       MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN points END) OVER (PARTITION BY season) AS champion_points
FROM standings s

datasets.name: ds_constructor_standings
queryLines:
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT season,
         constructor_name_as_of_race                     AS team,
         SUM(total_points)                               AS points,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)         AS wins,
         SUM(CASE WHEN is_podium THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)      AS podiums,
         SUM(CASE WHEN dnf_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)       AS dnfs,
         COUNT(DISTINCT driver_name)                     AS drivers
  FROM driver_performance
  WHERE constructor_name_as_of_race IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY season, constructor_name_as_of_race
)
SELECT season,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY points DESC)      AS position,
       team, points, wins, podiums, dnfs, drivers,
       MAX(points) OVER (PARTITION BY season) - points             AS gap_to_leader,
       MAX(points) OVER (PARTITION BY season)                      AS winning_team_points
FROM totals

datasets.name: ds_constructor_progression
queryLines:
WITH per_round AS (
  SELECT season, round, constructor_name_as_of_race AS team, SUM(total_points) AS pts
  FROM driver_performance
  WHERE constructor_name_as_of_race IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY season, round, constructor_name_as_of_race
)
SELECT season, round, team,
       SUM(pts) OVER (PARTITION BY season, team ORDER BY round
                      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_points
FROM per_round
